styleLock.direction: pop color-block beauty commerce with identity-free eye close-ups
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, flat solid pastel colour blocks #E9DDF2 / #C77FD4 / #C3CCF7 / #F5A9A2 for benefit, spec and lifestyle shots, never textured or graded
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright neutral high-key studio light with one hard directional key that throws a single crisp graphic shadow on colour blocks; soft wrap and skimming light on skin and macro detail
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper colour blocks laid flat, no props, no surface texture
styleLock.typography: bold geometric sans-serif display headlines only, oversized on flat colour, one family, no script or serif
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight hand-drawn arrow callouts and blank label chips in deep charcoal #2D2D2D, otherwise none
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 tube angle and scale, tube and its wand always read as one set, tube never cropped; every human presence is limited to an eye-region crop from brow to upper cheek or a nose-to-collarbone crop so no identity is legible
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent pop colour-block beauty ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, pale lilac #E9DDF2, orchid #C77FD4 and periwinkle #C3CCF7 with coral #F5A9A2 as the closing field; neutral high-key studio lighting with one hard directional key that casts a single crisp graphic shadow; bold geometric sans-serif display type only; thin single-weight arrow callouts and blank label chips in deep charcoal #2D2D2D; flat solid colour-block backgrounds with no texture and no gradient; stable slight 3/4 tube angle and scale with tube and wand presented as one set; people cropped to the eye region or nose-down so no identity is readable; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no gradient backdrops, no identifiable faces.

shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The closed tube standing upright, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible and centred in the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft frontal key plus fill, and one gentle contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace. Crisp edges, commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no faces, no watermark, no decorative graphics, no cut-off edges, no tinted or gradient background, no floating product.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 白底开盖瓶身与刷头并置；02 白底合盖正面瓶身；03 上下双格使用前后眼部微距并带英文标注；04 眼部微距刷头上睫瞬间加笔刷形色块角标；05 硬阳光上眼特写（雀斑毛孔真实肌理）；06 兰花紫背景整脸微笑持管近颊；07 长春花蓝平铺硬阴影开盖平置；08 珊瑚粉底重复瓶身斜向阵列；09 兰花紫平铺三支加刷头；10 长春花蓝信息图（大标语、两条手绘箭头标注、圆形上眼插图）；11 兰花紫九支不同盖色横排家族陈列加手写标语。品类判定依据：全部画面为着色眼妆件（刷头贴睫毛根上妆、成膜包裹睫毛），非护理清洁，故 L1 取美妆彩妆、L2 取眼妆，与源类目路径一致，源标题仅作事实提示。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与系列名、瓶盖上的王冠心形装饰图形、圆形功效徽章与全部英文功效句（改为 {selling_point_1}/{callout_1}/{callout_2} 空位）、双格前后两侧的主张文字、色卡陈列的色号名与手写家族标语、整脸模特身份（06 改写为鼻下至锁骨裁切，其余上眼画面限眉到颊裁切）、原平台促销角标与星级社会证明。结构处理：01 与 02 合并为一个白底 HERO 加一个开盖卖点 HERO，07 与 09 的两张硬阴影平铺合并为俯拍规格镜，11 张近重复源图合并为 10 镜；11 的家族色卡仅作 VARIANT 镜素材，不构成变体画廊。
